checks: Native content build projection binds the single buff_snowman_AtkUp curve across T1..T5 against independent frozen-row oracles (9/50, 21/100, 6/25, 27/100, 3/10 from CT_ForkBuff keys 1..5 with ERichCurveInterpMode::RCIM_Constant), checks the single-entry DataList parameter order and the bIsPercent=true unit hint, enforces ApplyGroupType FIVE against the wearer group (character:1019 mismatch rejected as incompatible), and retains the native description key buff_fork_snowman_effect.

Config validation: a proc on weapon:fork_Whale is rejected ('fork_snowman'), a zero-denominator ratio is rejected, and duplicate snowman procs at scenario validation are rejected ('duplicates'); weapon id match is case-insensitive and a legal config validates.

Runtime: the delivery-time oracle reads only positive, nonexpired settled ActorRuntime shields on the living wearer (damage_bonus reads ctx.actor.shields and writes via add_atk_percent into the live base-ATK-scaled atk_percent zone); a shield settled on another actor does not empower the wearer; the bonus stays out of the damage-bonus and final zones. The adapter executes in the real damage path (gear.rs damage-bonus chain), so projection.rs reports "runtime_execution_validated": true honestly; production code was not touched.

Proven Rust scenario (adler_shields.rs::adler_skill_and_snowman_use_settled_shields_through_switch_depletion_and_expiry): Adler Skill grants the modeled Blessing shield, the shielded T1 Normal hit adds base_atk * 9/50 (21909/50 = 2180 * 201/1000), exact incoming depletion (1800 absorbed by shields) removes the bonus (second Normal 402/1 = 2000 * 201/1000 unbuffed), a Normal at the half-open expiry boundary is unbuffed (201/1), and switching away and back preserves the shield on its captured recipient. The web scenario web/tests/combat/snowman.mjs is registered in web/tests/weapon_passives.test.mjs for CI but was not executed in this Linux environment (no WASM build).

Independent zone counterexample (snowman.rs::snowman_shielded_scenario_adds_base_atk_scaled_bonus): base_atk 1000 with compiled ATK 2000/1 at T1 while shielded deals 21909/50 non-crit damage = (2000 + 1000*9/50) * 201/1000, rejecting 11859/25, which is what multiplying the compiled ATK (2000 * 59/50 = 2360) would produce.

Full-scenario oracle without a shield: 1000 static ATK deals exactly 1000/1 non-crit damage through the synthetic caller-test action (atk_rate 1), proving the bonus is never silently applied as unconditional.
Exact-boundary oracle (snowman.rs::snowman_bonus_dead_at_exact_expiry): time_us == expires_at_us yields atk_percent == 0 (half-open shield interval), alongside the existing +/-1us expiry cases.

Exact-depletion oracle (snowman.rs::snowman_bonus_removed_when_incoming_damage_depletes_shield): incoming damage that exactly depletes the shield (100 absorbed, 0 HP loss) leaves no positive shield and atk_percent == 0.
Focused run: 11/11 snowman tests pass (8 pre-existing + 3 new); 9/9 adler_shields tests pass. rustfmt --check clean on the touched test file.
combat_scope: Wearer-only ATK percentage (18/21/24/27/30% T1..T5) active only while the wearer has at least one Shield with remaining_hp>0 and expires_at_us>time_us. The bonus joins the live base-ATK-scaled ATK sum (base_atk * p added to ATK via add_atk_percent), never multiplying compiled static ATK, and never leaks into the damage-bonus or final zones.
exclusive_character_scope: Frozen ExclusiveCharacterIDArray is empty; equipment legality follows ApplyGroupType.
independent_oracles: T1..T5 ATK percentages are the exact fractions 9/50, 21/100, 6/25, 27/100, 3/10, read from CT_ForkBuff buff_snowman_AtkUp keys 1..5 (RCIM_Constant) through the single-entry DataList [{buff_snowman_AtkUp, bIsPercent:true}]; the projection binds them 1:1 into GearProcConfig::SnowmanShieldAtk.atk_bonus (snowman_projection_binds_t1_t5_rejects_group_and_unit_changes).

Boundary rule: the bonus p applies only when at least one wearer shield has remaining_hp>0 AND expires_at_us>time_us with the wearer alive (actor.hp>0); time_us==expires_at_us -> 0 (half-open interval), remaining_hp==0 -> 0, actor.hp==0 -> 0, and a shield settled on another actor -> 0 (snowman_bonus_dead_at_exact_expiry, snowman_bonus_follows_shield_expiry, snowman_requires_a_positive_live_shield_on_the_packet_owner).

Zone counterexample: base_atk=1000, compiled ATK=2000/1, T1 (p=9/50), shielded, def=0, no crit -> live ATK = 2000 + 1000*9/50 = 2180/1; with the native Melee1 talent-1 coefficient 201/1000 (DT_SkillDamageData GE_Player_Adler_Melee1_Damage AtkRateBaseArray[0]) the hit deals 2180*201/1000 = 21909/50. The multiplicative misreading (compiled ATK * 59/50 = 2360) would give 2360*201/1000 = 11859/25, asserted unequal (snowman_shielded_scenario_adds_base_atk_scaled_bonus).

Unshielded baseline: 1000 static ATK with no shield deals exactly 1000/1 non-crit damage through the synthetic caller-test action (atk_rate 1/1), so the conditional bonus is never silently applied as unconditional (snowman_scenario_without_shield_deals_unbuffed_damage).
known_gaps: Global release availability is unverified in the frozen catalog.
Shields are observed only from modeled producers: the Adler Blessing shield is modeled (characters/adler/skill.rs); unmodeled shield producers cannot activate the bonus in the simulation.
The web scenario web/tests/combat/snowman.mjs is registered in web/tests/weapon_passives.test.mjs for CI; WASM is not built in this Linux environment, so the web test was not executed here.

passive_description.source: 当装备者具有护盾的时候，攻击力提升<lv>{0}</>。

tested_hypotheses: The {0} ATK percentage joins the live base-ATK-scaled ATK sum (base_atk * p added to ATK via add_atk_percent), never multiplying compiled static ATK, and stays out of the damage-bonus and final zones.
The bonus applies only when a positive, nonexpired shield is settled on the living wearer at packet delivery; another actor's shield does not count.
Incoming shield depletion and the half-open expiry deadline remove the bonus; switching away and back preserves the shield on its captured recipient.
